documentary.title: The Ancient Machine That Could Predict Eclipses
documentary.title_promise: A Greek geared machine predicted eclipses; researchers reconstructed how far its surviving clues can take us.
documentary.central_question: How could a corroded Greek machine calculate the sky, and what can researchers prove about its missing front?

research_dossier.claim: X-ray tomography and surface imaging supported a reconstruction in which the mechanism predicted lunar and solar eclipses using Babylonian arithmetic-progression cycles.
Researchers described 82 surviving fragments, including 30 corroded bronze gears, and proposed a model for the front display using inscriptions and physical clues.
research_dossier.source: Scientific Reports research article (Freeth et al., 2021)

research_dossier.claim: The Antikythera Mechanism was found among wreck material near the island of Antikythera by sponge divers.
Researchers distinguish established solar and lunar functions from uncertainties about origin, context, and purpose.

acts.name: Act I — The impossible object
acts.dramatic_question: What is this broken object, and why is it so difficult to explain?

acts.name: Act II — Reading the gears
acts.dramatic_question: What can the surviving mechanism and inscriptions actually tell us?

acts.name: Act III — The boundary of the answer
acts.dramatic_question: What is proven, what remains reconstructed, and why does the distinction matter?

open_loops.question: How could a hand-powered machine predict eclipses?
Did the surviving clues reveal a complete display of the ancient planets?

scenes.title: A machine that predicted eclipses
scenes.narration: Ancient Greeks built a machine that could predict eclipses.
scenes.story_progress: State the central puzzle and open L1.
scenes.reveal: The object is an astronomical calculator, not an ordinary clock.
scenes.pattern_interrupt: Macro gear snap-zoom with a single metallic impact.
scenes.story_purpose: Cold-open with the documented capability; immediately ask how.

visual_plan.description: A real fragment photograph, clearly labeled as the surviving artifact, then a restrained gear silhouette.
visual_plan.animation: Trace one visible gear tooth; label reconstruction as illustrative.
visual_plan.sound_effect: One low metallic click; no whoosh over the first line.

scenes.title: A wreck off a small island
scenes.narration: The mechanism came from wreck material near Antikythera, where sponge divers found it among ancient cargo.
scenes.story_progress: Move from the object to its find context.
scenes.reveal: The machine survived by accident inside a shipwreck.
scenes.story_purpose: Place the artifact in a real archaeological context.

visual_plan.description: Map from Greece to Antikythera; label it as a map, then show a shipwreck illustration.

scenes.title: The first puzzle
scenes.narration: What surfaced was corroded bronze, crowded with gear teeth and writing too small to read at a glance.
scenes.story_progress: Establish that the clues are physically difficult to read.
scenes.reveal: The inscriptions are evidence, not decoration.
scenes.story_purpose: Show why the artifact resisted easy explanation.

visual_plan.description: Museum photography or a clearly labeled illustrative macro of corroded bronze.

scenes.title: A computer in fragments
scenes.narration: Modern research describes 82 surviving fragments and 30 known bronze gear wheels, but the pieces do not preserve the whole machine.
scenes.story_progress: Quantify what survives and what does not.
scenes.pattern_interrupt: The full gear graphic breaks into fragments.
scenes.story_purpose: Set the scale of loss without pretending the reconstruction is complete.

visual_plan.description: Evidence image beside a labeled fragment-count graphic; reconstructed pieces use a different color.
visual_plan.camera_movement: Pull back to reveal missing space.
visual_plan.animation: 82 fragment markers; distinguish documented count from schematic arrangement.

scenes.title: The question sharpens
scenes.narration: If the front is missing and the metal is unreadable, how can anyone know what the machine calculated?
scenes.story_progress: Promise a method-based answer rather than a miracle reveal.
scenes.reveal: The answer must come from imaging, inscriptions, and gear geometry.
scenes.story_purpose: Turn the loss into the investigation's central method question.

visual_plan.description: Black field, fragment outline, then an X-ray-style cutaway labeled reconstruction.
visual_plan.animation: Layered fragment silhouette; mark the visualization as illustrative.

scenes.title: Seeing inside bronze
scenes.narration: Researchers used high-resolution X-ray tomography to inspect structures and inscriptions hidden inside surviving fragments.
scenes.story_progress: Move from mystery to a repeatable research method.
scenes.reveal: Imaging lets researchers examine hidden surfaces without treating guesses as facts.
scenes.story_purpose: Introduce the investigative tool and show evidence being recovered.

visual_plan.description: Research paper figure or a clearly labeled tomography visualization beside lab equipment.
visual_plan.animation: Reveal one scan slice at a time.

scenes.title: A dial with a long memory
scenes.narration: The rear dials encoded repeating calendar and eclipse cycles; the pattern turned moving gears into a way to track time.
scenes.story_progress: Connect physical gears to a measurable cycle.
scenes.reveal: The machine represented recurring patterns, not supernatural foresight.
scenes.pattern_interrupt: Animate one ring turning as the rest of the frame freezes.
scenes.story_purpose: Explain how cyclical motion can encode astronomical time.

visual_plan.description: Back-dial evidence image, with any clean dial overlay labeled as a diagram.
visual_plan.camera_movement: Orbit around a flat dial graphic.
visual_plan.animation: Simple repeating cycle diagram; cite the underlying research.

scenes.title: How the eclipse prediction worked
scenes.narration: A 2006 study reported that the mechanism predicted lunar and solar eclipses through cycles based on Babylonian arithmetic progressions.
scenes.story_progress: Answer the opening question with the cited research result.
scenes.reveal: The prediction came from encoded cycles, not an unexplained leap in technology.
scenes.pattern_interrupt: Eclipse shadow crosses a clean cycle chart.
scenes.story_purpose: Pay off L1 with the documented mechanism, carefully attributed.

visual_plan.description: Research-backed eclipse-cycle diagram; mark the graphic as an explanatory animation, not original footage.
visual_plan.animation: Animate the reported cycle as a simplified teaching diagram.

scenes.title: The writing on the machine
scenes.narration: Inscriptions also describe the Sun, Moon, and planets known in antiquity, raising a larger question about the machine's front.
scenes.story_progress: Expand from eclipse cycles to the contested front display.
scenes.reveal: Text clues point toward more than the surviving rear dials.
scenes.story_purpose: Introduce the new evidence and open L2.

visual_plan.description: Published inscription images or close detail; reconstructed text marked as transcription.
visual_plan.animation: Highlight only phrases discussed in the paper.

scenes.title: A more ambitious reconstruction
scenes.narration: A 2021 research team proposed a front display model that could represent the ancient Greek cosmos using compact gearing.
scenes.story_progress: Show the leading model and qualify its status.
scenes.reveal: A detailed model is not the same as a complete surviving machine.
scenes.story_purpose: Present the reconstruction as a published proposal, not settled artifact fact.

visual_plan.description: Use the 2021 paper's reconstruction figure or an original labeled diagram.
visual_plan.animation: Layer hypothetical components in amber; observed fragments in blue.

scenes.title: The clues that fit
scenes.narration: The model combines inscription readings, surviving gear geometry, and astronomical period relations to explain how a compact display might work.
scenes.story_progress: Show multiple constraints converging on one reconstruction.
scenes.reveal: The reconstruction is constrained by evidence, though some parts remain hypothetical.
scenes.story_purpose: Explain the basis of the 2021 proposal without implying consensus beyond the article.

visual_plan.description: Three evidence columns converge on a clearly marked hypothetical gear layout.

scenes.title: Why a model can be elegant
scenes.narration: A reconstruction can satisfy the known clues and still describe parts that no fragment preserves directly.
scenes.story_progress: Prepare the audience to distinguish evidence from inference.
scenes.reveal: Fit to evidence strengthens a model but does not turn every component into an observed fact.
scenes.pattern_interrupt: Hypothetical parts fade away, leaving observed fragments.
scenes.story_purpose: Teach viewers how historical reconstruction handles missing evidence.

visual_plan.description: Side-by-side fragment and reconstruction, with direct evidence separated from inferred parts.
visual_plan.camera_movement: Rack focus between fragment and model.

scenes.title: The missing front
scenes.narration: The 2021 authors explicitly note that evidence for the Sun and planetary mechanisms is missing, so parts of their model are theoretical.
scenes.story_progress: Name what cannot be demonstrated from surviving components.
scenes.reveal: The planets display is a proposal constrained by clues, not a fully recovered original assembly.
scenes.story_purpose: State the key limit directly and prepare payoff for L2.

visual_plan.description: Show surviving fragments first, then dashed outlines for theoretical gearing.
visual_plan.camera_movement: Hold on gaps in the fragments.

scenes.title: The honest answer
scenes.narration: The planet-display proposal answers what may have fit; it does not prove that every reconstructed gear existed exactly this way.
scenes.story_progress: Pay off the planetary-display question without overstating certainty.
scenes.reveal: The strongest answer is a bounded reconstruction, not a claim of certainty.
scenes.pattern_interrupt: A bold model title is replaced by a smaller “proposed reconstruction” label.
scenes.story_purpose: Resolve L2 with a calibrated conclusion.

visual_plan.description: Reconstruction model beside the paper's limitation statement.
visual_plan.camera_movement: Pull back to show both evidence and uncertainty.

scenes.title: What is still unknown
scenes.narration: The device's origin, exact context, and purpose still carry uncertainty, even where its astronomical functions are well studied.
scenes.story_progress: Leave a truthful mystery after resolving the technical puzzle.
scenes.reveal: Knowing what a machine calculated does not identify its maker or full social purpose.
scenes.story_purpose: Separate functional evidence from broader unanswered historical questions.

visual_plan.description: Artifact in museum context, with no invented portrait of its maker.

scenes.title: The true scale of the achievement
scenes.narration: What survives is enough to show an ancient technology built around mathematical cycles, intricate gears, and careful astronomical observation.
scenes.story_progress: Reframe the story around demonstrated ingenuity rather than a mythic lost civilization.
scenes.reveal: The wonder is not that the machine did everything; it is what the evidence shows it could do.
scenes.pattern_interrupt: The music opens as observed gear teeth turn in sequence.
scenes.story_purpose: Deliver the emotional meaning grounded in evidence.

visual_plan.description: Artifact details and simple cycle animation, clearly separated from the speculative full model.
visual_plan.camera_movement: Slow orbit over documented fragment photography.
visual_plan.animation: Evidence-only gears animate; speculative elements stay dim.

scenes.title: The payoff
scenes.narration: So how did it predict eclipses? By turning recurring astronomical cycles into motion; the broken gears preserve part of that calculation, not every answer.
scenes.story_progress: Close L1 and summarize the boundary between known and unknown.
scenes.reveal: The mechanism's achievement is real, and the missing evidence still matters.
scenes.story_purpose: Return to the opening and state the complete, nuanced answer.

visual_plan.description: Cycle animation resolves into the surviving fragment; label diagram as explanatory.
visual_plan.camera_movement: Push from orbit diagram back to artifact.

scenes.title: Outro and next question
scenes.narration: If this evidence-first mystery stayed with you, thank you for watching. Like, comment, and subscribe, and join the next documentary as we investigate another machine history nearly lost.
scenes.story_progress: Invite a return through a related evidence-led story.
scenes.story_purpose: Short natural CTA after the story has reached a satisfying conclusion.

visual_plan.description: Quiet artifact end card with space for a related documentary card; no fabricated thumbnail.
